description.value: Konig Meat and Sausage Company is a locally owned butcher shop, deli, and grocery in Invermere, BC, operating in a tradition stretching back to a butcher on the same site since 1917. The shop produces award-winning gourmet sausages on-site using old-world European techniques, and co-owner Micheal Hecken won the first-ever BC Best Butcher competition. Touring cyclists will find a well-stocked deli with daily lunch specials, house-made meats, jerky, pepperoni, and imported European grocery items — a serious resupply stop in the Columbia Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetched successfully and provides full contact details (address, phone, email) that were absent from OSM tags. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those all remain null. The OSM amenity=cafe tag is a mismatch — this is a butcher shop and deli, not a cafe — flagged in concerns, though Food & Drink remains the correct top-level category.
